# pending

Pending records of writers whose installs lost their local roots: one open record naming every kind of end, stopped partway; three that writer `settler` finished, rolled back and dismissed; one its own entry closed; from a folder whose moves copy, one stopped with its markers and one cut short before its bytes landed. The local root is `settler`'s.

Written by toshokan 0.1.0 with `cargo test -p toshokan --test format -- --ignored --exact generate::fixtures`, from `tests/format/generate.rs`: seeds 21 to 29, a `TestClock` from 1000 ms, `PrefixIdentity` over 64 KiB and the layout `.t`.
